product_metadata.title: Seven20 Harry Potter Ceramic Spice Jars with Hogwarts Houses, set of 4 - Store Potion Ingredients, Herbs, Spices and More - with Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Slytherin and Ravenclaw Symbols - 1.45 oz each
features: Never be unprepared for Potions class again with this set of 4 Harry Potter Ceramic Storage Jars!
The ceramic jars feature a cork lined stopper lid to preserve all your potion ingredients, such as herbs, spices, eye of newt, lacewing flies, boomslang skin and more!
Each jar features a symbol from the four houses of Hogwarts: Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Slytherin and Ravenclaw.

Perfect for wizards and muggles alike, these jars make a great gift for fans of the Harry Potter books and movie series who wish to succeed in Potions Class or make their own batch of Polyjuice potion.
Officially licensed Harry Potter merchandise. PACKAGING MAY VARY. Ceramic. Hand wash only. Capacity: 1.45 oz. Measure: 3 3/4"h x 1 5/8"w
